results.title: Cross-Border Stablecoin Invoicing for Freelancers | Support
results.description: Five corridors dominate cross-border freelance stablecoin invoicing today, each with different chain and asset preferences. ​ · Common asset: USDC on Polygon or Base. Common alternative: USDT on Tron. Use case: US agencies billing Argentinian, Brazilian, or Mexican contractors; reverse direction for LatAm freelancers billing US clients. Argentina’s peso volatility makes USD-pegged stablecoins materially better than peso wires, Chainalysis’ 2024 Latin America report documents stablecoin payments displacing both peso wires and Western Union remittances.
